Missing locks/randomUUID, storage get/set/readback/remove faults and malformed versioned record fail closed. UUIDv4 attemptId distinguishes identical successive attempts and prevents stale acknowledgement ABA.

Removal takes same lock, re-reads exact shared plus legacy bytes and requires unchanged acknowledged snapshot; another pending tab refuses removal with explicit busy feedback. Storage event only refreshes UI.

wireExchangeReview only captures existing deadline before close and passes consumed generation/deadline to commit. Only wallet callbacks consume grant; unrelated callbacks retain existing semantics.

Legacy migration never removes session evidence and never overwrites shared evidence; conflicts become conservative generic reminder. No private payload, recipient, amount, memo, signature, identity or credential added.
Retention text states browser/site persistence until explicit removal; no timer, telemetry, new dependency or backend writer.

local_ops_rehearsal.limitations: Only disposable pytest files mutate. Runtime/public calls mocked in rehearsal; host preflight independently read-only.

limitations: Guarantee covers cooperating upgraded same-origin/browser-partition pages, not already-loaded older HTML, cleared storage, other devices or profiles.

Multiple historical session-only attempts cannot be globally enumerated; migration publishes at most one shared record and preserves conflicting legacy records per tab. It does not prove their outcomes.
Explicit user acknowledgement is a reconciliation checkpoint, not chain evidence; no actual SDK reconnect/signature/money/customer read performed.
Rollback restores previous HTML for future loads and cannot stop wallet requests or replace active JavaScript. Shared record may survive while older code ignores it.
Separate acceptance reviewer and parent own browser/product regression results; this receipt does not independently attest their outcomes.
